title: Shift square for the exact derived evaluation comparison
statement: Let C,D be closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. Let F:C->D be an additive exact strong monoidal left adjoint preserving flat objects. Equip D(F) with the transported canonical derived monoidal structure [lem-sf-exact-closed-derived-hom]. For M in D(C), equip RHom_C(-,M) and RHom_D(-,D(F)M) with any coherent integer shifts satisfying the all-degree normalization of [lem-sf-native-derived-hom-signed-exact]. The natural transformation with components D(F)RHom(K,M)->RHom(D(F)K,D(F)M) given by the canonical evaluation transpose commutes with their induced integer shifts. This statement asserts only the shift square; it assumes neither exactness of the two Hom functors nor invertibility of the comparison.

proof.text: Represent M by a K-injective I, and resolve FI->J by a K-injective target. Form the ordinary Hom-complex comparison followed by postcomposition to J. On K-flat tensor representatives, uncurrying identifies its localization with exactly the canonical derived evaluation transpose.

proof.text: Signed reindexing commutes with the ordinary comparison and with postcomposition. Localize this equation, identify the adjoint source shifts by evaluation, and multiply both rows by the common quadratic scalar. This is exactly the CommShift equation for any normalized structures.

theorem exactDerivedHomComparison_shift
    {C : Type c} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    {D : Type d} [Category.{u + 1} D] [Abelian D]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} D] [MonoidalCategory D]
    [MonoidalPreadditive D] [MonoidalClosed D] [BraidedCategory D]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [F.PreservesFlat] [F.IsLeftAdjoint] [F.Monoidal] (M : DerivedCategory C)
    (sC : (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M).CommShift ℤ)
    (sD : (MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)).CommShift ℤ)
    (hC : letI := sC; ∀ (K : DerivedCategory C) (n : ℤ),
      ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M).commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
        (n * (n + 1) / 2).negOnePow • (siteHomOppositeSourceShift K n).hom.app M)
    (hD : letI := sD; ∀ (K : DerivedCategory D) (n : ℤ),
      ((MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)).commShiftIso n).hom.app
          (op K) = (n * (n + 1) / 2).negOnePow •
            (siteHomOppositeSourceShift K n).hom.app (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)) :
    letI := sC
    letI := sD
    letI := exactClosedDerivedMonoidal F
    ∀ β : MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
      F.mapDerivedCategory.op ⋙ MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj (F.mapDerivedCategory.obj M),
      (∀ K, β.app (op K) = closedComparison F.mapDerivedCategory K M) →
        NatTrans.CommShift β ℤ
